    <h2>{`Overview`}</h2>
    <p>{`Most buttons in Maximo Mobile are displayed as icon-only to minimize scrolling and maximize screen space. While this creates a clean interface, it can be challenging for new users who are unfamiliar with the icons. Tooltips provide contextual help by displaying descriptive text when users interact with buttons.`}</p>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Use Cases:`}</strong></p>
    <ul>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Icon-only buttons that need clarification`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Improving accessibility for screen readers`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Helping new users learn the interface`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Meeting WCAG accessibility standards`}</li>
    </ul>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Prerequisites:`}</strong></p>
    <ul>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Access to MAF Configuration application`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Basic understanding of XML button elements`}</li>
    </ul>
    <h2>{`Implementation`}</h2>
    <h3>{`Step 1: Identify buttons that need tooltips`}</h3>
    <p>{`Review your application and identify icon-only buttons that would benefit from tooltips. Focus on:`}</p>
    <ul>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Frequently used actions (Save, Delete, Edit)`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Non-obvious icons`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Critical functions`}</li>
    </ul>
    <h3>{`Step 2: Add the icon-aria-label attribute`}</h3>
    <p>{`Add the `}<inlineCode parentName="p">{`icon-aria-label`}</inlineCode>{` attribute to your button element with descriptive text:`}</p>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`XML Configuration:`}</strong></p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-xml"
      }}>{`<!-- Button with tooltip -->
<button icon-aria-label="Report Work" 
        icon="carbon:report" 
        on-click="navigateToReportWork" 
        on-click-arg="{woDetailResource.item}" 
        kind="secondary" 
        id="m5kg3"/>
`}</code></pre>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Attribute Explanation:`}</strong></p>
    <ul>
      <li parentName="ul"><inlineCode parentName="li">{`icon-aria-label`}</inlineCode>{` - The text displayed in the tooltip and read by screen readers`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><inlineCode parentName="li">{`icon`}</inlineCode>{` - The icon to display (Carbon icon library)`}</li>

      <li parentName="ul"><inlineCode parentName="li">{`kind`}</inlineCode>{` - Button style (primary, secondary, ghost, etc.)`}</li>
    </ul>

    <p><strong parentName="p">{`On Mobile (iOS/Android):`}</strong></p>
    <ul>

    <p><strong parentName="p">{`✅ Do:`}</strong></p>

      <li parentName="ul">{`Use action verbs (“Report Work”, “Delete Item”, “Edit Details”)`}</li>
